payload.definition: A single-file model format used by llama.cpp. One file contains everything needed to run inference.
Video RAM — the memory on your GPU. Models load here for fast inference. More VRAM = bigger models.
A named job that needs a model. 'Brain' is a slot. 'Voice' is a slot. Assign a model to a slot to enable that ability.
Compressing model weights to use less memory. Q4 = 4-bit (smallest), Q8 = 8-bit, F16 = 16-bit (full precision).
A model that converts text into a vector (list of numbers). Similar texts produce similar vectors, enabling semantic search.
A model that scores how relevant a document is to a query. Runs after the embedder to refine search results.
Running a model to get a response. When the AI 'thinks' and produces text, that's inference.
How much text a model can read at once. Measured in tokens (roughly 1 token = 0.75 words). 4K tokens ~ 3,000 words.
The wizard's read on your hardware — High / Mid / Low / CPU. Drives which preset is recommended so you don't end up with a model that won't fit.
A bundle of model picks tuned for a given tier. Saves you from guessing what to download — the preset author already mapped 'High tier' to 'Nemotron 9B + SigLIP HD + Harrier 0.6B' (etc).
A Rust-native deep-learning framework. DevPulse uses it for the embedder + Harrier 0.6B minion — pure Rust, no FFI tax, fast token loops.
Hugging Face's Rust deep-learning framework. DevPulse uses it for vision models like SigLIP HD where HF interop is the win.
The battle-tested C++ inference engine for GGUF models. DevPulse links it via FFI for chat brains (Nemotron, Llama-class) where its kernels win on throughput.
A multi-model database DevPulse runs in-process (no sidecar, no port). Holds the persona graph + reasoning memories with graph queries instead of joins.
A vector database. DevPulse embeds it in-process for nearest-neighbor search across memory embeddings — that's how the brain finds the relevant past turn for your new question.
DevPulse's source-of-truth relational store (SQLite-compatible). Holds chat sessions, turns, slot assignments, and user preferences — anything that's structured + needs ACID.
An embedded columnar analytics database. DevPulse uses it for span traces and telemetry — anything where you want to ask 'across all the last 10K events, how often did X happen' fast.
Reasoning-Ready Object — a zero-copy pre-archived memory shape (text + embedding + 1-hop neighbors). Lets recall surface the surrounding graph without re-querying.
Model Context Protocol — Anthropic's spec for tools, resources, and prompts that LLMs can call. DevPulse exposes one MCP entry so Claude Code / Claude Desktop can plug in.
A reasoning mode where multiple small models vote on a question and the brain summarizes the consensus. Trades latency for breadth of opinion.
A small, fast model that does the pre-work for the brain — embedding, classification, retrieval scoring. Currently Harrier 0.6B running on Burn.
The main chat LLM (e.g. Nemotron 7.6B, Llama 3.1, Phi-15B). It produces the reply; the minion does the prep.
Stored intermediate tensors from past tokens so the model can skip recomputing context on every new token. Bigger context = bigger cache = more VRAM.
An in-process Rust cache library DevPulse uses for hot reads (registry lookups, slot resolutions). Bounded size, TTL-evicting, lock-free.
